question: What brilliant and golden Lakṣmī is Jātavedas asked to bring to the speaker?
premises: Jātavedas is addressed in split vocative form.
Lakṣmī is described as brilliant and golden.
The speaker requests her arrival to him.
inference: The verse petitions Jātavedas to bring the brilliant, golden Lakṣmī to the speaker.
plain_english: O Jātavedas, bring the brilliant, golden Lakṣmī to me.
